'''Chak juice''' was a beverage created by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. It was popularly sold during the Ewok [[Festival of Love]] celebrations.

==Description==
Chak juice was considered tasty, and was made from a substance which [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] called [[Chak (substance)|Chak]]. This substance came from the [[Spirit Tree (Endor)|Spirit Tree]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The beverage was [[Color/Legends|purplish]] in color.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
During the Ewok [[Festival of Love]] of [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|purchased]] this beverage from [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] in the various celebratory [[City/Legends|cities]], including [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Kaadara]], [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], and the [[Southern Ewok Lake Village]].<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', Chak juice was introduced to the [[Star Wars video games|game]] during the Ewok Festival of Love of [[2008]]. In the game, Chak juice could be purchased for 2,000 credits. However, this price was probably a mere game mechanic, and may not reflect the true cost of the [[:w:c:swg:Drink|beverage]]. Chak juice was once again sold during subsequent [[:w:c:swg:Ewok Festival of Love|Festival of Love]] celebrations in [[2009]], [[2010]], and [[2011]].
